chunks: Al-Bazanti narrated from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who took funds for hajj from a man, then the road was cut off against him. Then another man gave him another hajj fund. Is that permissible for him?

He said: "That is permissible for him. It is counted for the first and the second, and there was no room for him to do other than what he did when he found someone who would provide him with the hajj funds."

key_terms.الطَّرِيقُ: the road or travel route to hajj
key_terms.الْأَوَّلِ: the first provider of the hajj funds
key_terms.حَجَّةً: funds or provision for undertaking hajj in this report
key_terms.فَقُطِعَ: he was cut off or obstructed on the route

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to accept a second hajj provision if the first funded journey is interrupted?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person undertaking hajj on financial provision from another when the journey is obstructed and a second person then funds the hajj. The Imam عليه السلام rules that accepting the second provision is permissible, and that the act is counted for both the first and the second providers.
